historical_record.headline: S.F. opens Mandarin program in school that once housed Spanish-speaking immigrant kids

historical_record.description: The school building here was built in 1911 and was for many years an elementary school serving Noe Valley.

The Clement Primary School, renamed the Kate Kennedy School, a fifteen-classroom school, with reinforced-concrete basement and first storey and a wood frame above, was taken over by the Board of Education; designed in the city's Bureau of Architecture, it was built by Hansborough Bros. on a $53,056 general contract.

unknowns: The assessor's roll gives 1900 as the year this structure was built, not 1911.
